buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 3. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 4. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Account Payee Demand Draft also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). DD should be made in favour of Dy. FA & CAO/C/KOTA payable at KOTA . After award of contract, Successful Bidder can upload scanned copy of the DD in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy to the original DD to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC

Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Buyer Added text-based ATC clauses 1. Hiring of NON-AC MUV vehicle is required for SSE/JE construction for movement to various st ations and section of NAD-KOTA-MTJ, Motipura, RMA-BPL and other working ongoing sites as per re quirement of Railways. Vehicle station location will be changed as per railway requirement at any t ime which is binding on the service provider. 2. Vehicle will have to be made available according to requirement and demand for the use of Railway Administration from 00.00 to 24.00 Hrs from the start date of the contract agreement till t he date of completion of contractor. The vehicle will be permitted to be withdrawn for servicing an d maintenance etc. only after an alternative vehicle same category MUV should be made available during that period. 3. Vehicle should be mechanically sound and shall be maintained decently with neat and clean inter iors and should be capable to run on kuccha road also. The driver should possess good behavior a nd proper uniform for which no additional payment will be provided by Railways, to ensure satisfac tory service under the contract. Railway shall have right to reject the vehicle if not found satisfacto ry as per the norms. 4. The Vehicle should be self-starting, in good running condition and the year of model of vehicle sh ould not be older than 2024. 5. The vehicle should be available for any outstation duty during the contract period. Rate shall incl ude payments to RTO, labour authorities, local municipal authorities taxes, fees and all the other c harges which are necessary for continuance of the service under the contract. 6. Working of the Railway is 24x7, hence driver may be called at any time in emergent situation. Co ntractor must ensure availability of driver whenever they are called. In case if the vehicle gone out side and have to stay there, all expenses towards driver and vehicle will be paid by the contractor. 7. During the working period, the vehicle may be Parked at the stipulated office premises or else wh ere as per the discretion of Concerned user who is using the vehicle. 8. The Cost of Petrol/diesel/CNG, mobile oil, toll tax, entry tax etc. for the use of the vehicle along wi th the salary of driver at the time of hire shall be provided by the contractor at his own cost includi ng the wages of staff if required any, no additional payment will be provided by Railways. In case t here is Diesel/petrol/CNG hike during the contract period. No extra payment on this account will be paid. Contractor shall ensure that enough fuel is available in the vehicle all the time. 9. Contractor shall be responsible for all the repair, loss, damage etc. to the vehicle and driver due t o any accident during the period of hire. 10. In case vehicle goes out of order, an alternate vehicle of same category MUV must be arranged wi thin a reasonable time not exceeding 12 hrs. All relevant document of the alternate vehicle to be made available before bringing vehicle for run. This shall be checked by Concerned office. 11. All Documents including competency of driver (Driving license), PUC, Registration of vehicle and I nsurance must be available on the vehicle. Police verification from the police station of his resident ial address as mentioned in Aadhar Card has to be done by the Contractor. 12. The expenditure on day-to-day maintenance, comprehensive insurance, registration and road tax etc. of the vehicle shall be borne by the contractor no additional payment will be provided by Rail ways. 13. Contractor shall maintain a record for daily meter reading which shall jointly signed by the Railwa y officer using the vehicle and driver of the vehicle. It will be the responsibility of the driver of the v ehicle to ensure that the daily kilometer reading are properly filled in and any over writing/cutting should be got authenticated by the officer using the vehicle. 14. In case of any defects got developed during running of Vehicle and pointed out by Railway Authori ty, necessary repairs and replacement should be carried out immediately by the contractor at his own cost no additional payment will be provided by Railways.

15. The contractor should fulfil all statutory requirements with respect to labour laws like minimum w ages to driver, PF, ESI etc. He/she will bear all liability in terms of Workman's Compensation Act in case of accidents/inquiry of his employee. 16. The contractor shall ensure that the vehicle is available every day. Contractor shall provide a goo d condition spare wheel and tools kit with the vehicle. 17. The evaluation of the bid will be done as per the criteria uploaded by the Railways in Additional Te rms and Conditions (ATC). 18. The billing of vehicle will be done on monthly basis. The contractor shall quote monthly rate for hi ring of above-mentioned vehicle which shall include all charges towards fuel, maintenance of Vehi cle, salary & other expenses towards driver, any taxes, fees and other charges as applicable towar ds state authorities including any other charges required for execution of this contract should be t aken considered. 19. The bid value is consisting of the total tender schedule value of the tender schedule. The bid valu e is inclusive of the applicable GST. 20. Penalties will be as per the GEM conditions. 21. For variation GCC for services 2018 para 5.3.4 shall be applicable. 22. The bid value is consisting of the total tender schedule value of the tender schedule as attached b elow. The bid value is inclusive of the applicable GST. The bidder shall quote its offer against the Bi d value shown in the bid. 23. The bidder shall be required to submit an undertaking certifying the truthfulness of all the docum ents submitted/uploaded along with the tender. This shall be mandatory for all the bidders. In case of failure of the bidder to submit the undertaking, their offer shall be summarily rejected. 24. The vehicle shall normally be used in section in Nagda-Kota-Mathura 3rd and 4th line project , RMA-BPL, Motipura project, and other working ongoing sites as per requirement of Railways on all type of road i.e. Pucca Kutcha service road etc and depending upon the requirement. 25. In case of any dispute regarding the scope of work and any other condition of contr act the decision of EEE/C/KOTA will be final. .
